data.title: Bake room lighting for a runtime
data.summary: A fixed room, non-overlapping lightmap UVs and one moving character. An LLM-assisted recipe with a concrete practice case, visual procedure and review gates.

facts.text: LightmapGI supplies precomputed lighting with engine-specific setup requirements.

prerequisites: An authorized Blender shaders / runtime materials environment and a recorded tool version. Blender-specific references here are pinned to the 4.5 manual; check differences in your installed version.
Practice inputs: A fixed room, non-overlapping lightmap UVs and one moving character.

Permission to use the source assets and a writable derived-output location. Use a disposable project copy for edits. An MCP connection is optional; reviewed scripts or manual tool actions can follow the same procedure.
steps: Inspect the existing project, asset registry and target runtime for an equivalent static lightmap workflow. Reuse the closest source and preserve its original files.

Give Claude Code, Codex or another authorized coding assistant this practice brief: A fixed room, non-overlapping lightmap UVs and one moving character. Ask for a small plan and parameter/script diff; verify names and APIs against the installed tool version before applying it.
Mark static geometry and configure the engine's lightmap UV/import settings
Bake a small room candidate with the chosen static lights on an authorized render machine
Test the moving character with the runtime's intended indirect-light solution

Save the derived candidate separately, record software versions and source/output identities, then perform the acceptance checks. Keep unresolved quality, performance and rights questions in the receipt.
data.output: A versioned bake room lighting for a runtime candidate, the input/parameter table, source identity and a review receipt with the checks below.
validation: Static surfaces have no unexplained seams or double lighting
Moving objects do not inherit fixed shadows painted into their base color
Record actual observations separately from expected results; missing tests remain unrun.
limitations: A Blender render bake is not automatically an engine-compatible LightmapGI result.
Sintra-authored proposal, not an executed Blender/engine/solver test. The diagram illustrates the procedure and is not a render or execution receipt.
Cloud chat cannot directly control a local 3D app without an appropriate authorized bridge. Tool access, model availability, paid services and rendering resources must be checked separately.
tips: Keep reusable prop albedo separate from room-specific baked illumination.
Let the LLM draft and explain bounded changes; use deterministic software to measure geometry, calculate trajectories and validate files.

data.prompt: Help me bake room lighting for a runtime in [existing authorized project]. First find an equivalent asset/workflow and inspect the installed tool version. Practice brief: A fixed room, non-overlapping lightmap UVs and one moving character. Propose the smallest parameter or script diff and explain each tool action. Follow the linked procedure, preserve original assets and stop on missing inputs or unsupported APIs. Check: Static surfaces have no unexplained seams or double lighting; Moving objects do not inherit fixed shadows painted into their base color. Return actual observations, source/output identities and blockers. Do not call expected results completed tests or publish private source paths.
